external.description: logged as applied; the client opens their sites

free.description: Easy Apply jobs covered by today's free applications

paid.description: Easy Apply jobs past the free allowance

problems.description: jobs that block the batch; drop them and retry

current_salary.description: nil when the candidate keeps it private

fee_paise.description: what the request would cost in all

companies.description: Companies the user currently belongs to (approved memberships).

is_platform_admin.description: PlatformAdmin: the user's ecosystem ID is in PLATFORM_ADMIN_IDS.

expires_at.description: ExpiresAt is the session's absolute end; the user logs in again after it.

viewer_role.description: ViewerRole is the signed-in viewer's role when they are a current member.

spent_this_month_paise.description:
SpentThisMonthPaise is what job posts took from the company wallet this
IST calendar month; TotalCapsPaise sums the limits of current non-admin members.

cap_type.description:
Company-credit allowance (HR and employees; admins have no cap). SpentPaise is the
current cap period's spending: this IST month for a monthly cap.

confirm_paid.description:
ConfirmPaid agrees to pay the apply fee from the wallet when today's
free applications are used up.

confirm_paid_count.description: ConfirmPaidCount must equal the dry run's paid count when it's above 0.

status.description: Status is accepted (the default) or withdrawn.

applied_at.description:
Viewer-specific: when the signed-in viewer applied, and whether they
own the job (recruiter or an admin of its company).

checkout.description: Checkout is set on an out-of-pocket post: open the gateway with it.

company.description:
CompanyID/CompanySlug are nil for free and unlinked jobs; CompanyName
then falls back to the text the recruiter typed (or "").

company_name.description: shown when there is no linked company

company_slug.description: paid: an approved company of the poster

designation.description: job title; becomes a designation term

credits_allowance_paise.description:
CreditsAllowancePaise is what the user may still spend from the company
wallet: null for admins (no cap, only the balance), 0 for employees.

job_ids.description: restrict to these ids, e.g. the user's saved jobs

location_ids.description: leaf city ids, flattened from the tristate tree by the client

min_salary_inr.description: client converts the user's currency with rates.json

query.description:
Query matches job titles only (requirements: job search is by
designation/title, never description text).

unlock_id.description: sort=match: from POST /jobs/search/unlocks for these filters

charged_paise.description: 0 when these filters were already unlocked, or the fee is 0

actor_name.description: who topped up or spent (matters on company wallets)

daily.description: one entry per day, oldest first

from.description: first and last day of the period, IST

peak_day.description: nil when the period had no activity

current_salary_visibility.description:
Privacy (newer doc §12): VisibleAll, VisibleApplied ("Applied Jobs
Only": recruiters of jobs the candidate applied to) or, for the current
salary only, VisibleHidden.

is_serving_notice.description:
IsServingNotice mirrors Availability == "Serving notice"; older clients
that send only this flag still set that availability.

notice.description:
Notice is the job-filter bucket ("30 days"). When NoticeUnit is set it
is derived from NoticeValue + NoticeUnit (e.g. 2 + "months").

saved.description: read-only: false for a starter profile not yet stored

skills.description: read-only on save: every skill, in display order

uses.description: Uses is how many jobs reference the term (admin list only).

countries_with_jobs_companies.description: CountriesWithJobsCompanies: company headquarters plus open jobs' locations.

countries_with_users.description: CountriesWithUsers: countries of the locations on candidate profiles.

hr_professionals.description:
HRProfessionals: people who can recruit (current admins and HR of a
live company) or have posted a job.

open_jobs.description: OpenJobs: listings search shows (active, visible, listed, at most 30 days old).
